newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran rebuilds areas destroyed by February quake.
newsitem.headline: Iran rebuilds areas destroyed by February quake.

text.p: Iran has begun rebuilding thousands of homes destroyed by a deadly earthquake in the country's northwestern Ardabil province in February, the region's governor general said on Sunday.

Nearly 1,000 people were killed, about 2,600 injured and 36,000 left homeless in the February 28 quake which rocked the mountainous area with an intensity of 5.5 on the Richter scale. More than 920 aftershocks were recorded.

"A credit of 50 billion rials ($17 million) has been allocated to rebuild the quake-hit areas," Governor General Mahmoud Ahmadi-Nejad said, as quoted by the official Iranian news agency IRNA. Reconstruction of 6,250 homes had already begun, he said.
"It is expected that 8,500 homes will be fully constructed before the approach of (the) winter season," Ahmadi-Nejad added.

IRNA said on Saturday Iran's president elect Mohammad Khatami was currently touring the cities of Birjand and Qaen in eastern Iran where a May 10 earthquake measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale killed more than 1,500 people.
The agency said reconstruction of quake-stricken areas would begin in the presence of the president-elect.
($1= 3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
